caption:
Wednesday's Sky is Yin Earth, The Fertile Field 🌾 Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's fertile field meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Earth gets a friend day, Yin Fire gets a joy day, Yin Water feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which line is too accurate? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #fiveelements #chineseastrology #humpday #selfdiscovery #dailyhoroscope #worklife #fourpillars #singapore
day_line: A fertile field on an Ox day. Patient and hardworking: good for steady chores and caring for people, easy to get stuck in a rut.

lines.Yang Wood: Small savings add up today. Pack lunch and put the difference aside.
lines.Yin Wood: A useful opening shows up today. Reply first, polish later.
lines.Yang Fire: Your ideas want out today. Share one at the meeting, not all five.
lines.Yin Fire: Midweek feels lighter for you. Treat the team to a round of kopi.
lines.Yang Earth: Two cooks, one kitchen today. Split the tasks clearly and nobody gets burnt.
lines.Yin Earth: Familiar faces lift you today. Suggest a hawker dinner after work.
lines.Yang Metal: A patient mentor helps today. Ask the question you've been saving.
lines.Yin Metal: A slow lunch clears your head today. Your best answer arrives with dessert.
lines.Yang Water: Your reliability gets noticed today. Hand in the report a little early.
lines.Yin Water: Wednesday piles it on today. Tackle the heaviest task while the coffee's hot.
